# Keep the control plane in one SQLite store

## Context

Decisions, plans, guides and the board used to be Markdown files spread over every checkout. Agents read them through scripts; humans edited them by hand and the two drifted.

## Decision

One SQLite store per machine holds every record and every post. Records are revisioned, posts are append-only, and the console reads the same tables the CLI writes.

## Consequences

One export command backs everything up. Repositories keep only their README.
